header.title: Tell us what happened
header.subtitle: Share as much or as little as you're comfortable with. Everything you write here is confidential.

confirmation.title: Your report has been received
confirmation.body: A case manager will review your report and reach out to help. You can track the status of your case at any time.

loading.title: We're reviewing your case securely...
loading.subtitle: This takes just a moment. Your information is encrypted and private.

anonymous.label: Stay anonymous
anonymous.on: Your identity will be hidden from case workers reviewing your report.
anonymous.off: Your name may be visible to the case worker assigned to help you.

title.label: Brief title for your case
title.placeholder: e.g. I need legal protection from my partner
title.required: A brief title helps us understand your situation
title.minLength: Title must be at least 3 characters

description.label: What happened?
description.placeholder: Describe what happened in your own words. Take your time — there's no rush and no word limit.
description.required: Please describe your situation so we can help
description.minLength: Please provide at least a few sentences

category.heading: What kind of help do you need most?
category.hint: This is optional — our team will assess your needs regardless.

form.error: Something went wrong while submitting your report. Please try again.

reassurance.named: Your report is encrypted end-to-end. Only assigned case workers will see your information.
reassurance.anon: Your report is encrypted end-to-end. Only assigned case workers will see your information, and your identity will remain hidden.
